_comment: Every InSIS page type -> its node in 02-redesign.md (draft 17). node: where it lives; also: where it is linked from or shown; variants: parameter-specific nodes, keyed as follows — 'name=value' is a literal InSIS value, a bare 'name' means that parameter is present, 'predmet=mine' means the course is one of mine, 'no predmet' / 'no zalozka' mean the parameter is absent. form: an action form seen in the crawl, kept on its own InSIS page; action: link (performed through InSIS's own links) | unverified (expected but not offered when crawled). read: background | on-open (only when the student opens it or a page that shows it) | never; fetch / links: parameter-name sets InSIS+ may read / link with ('' = no parameters), not counting transient_params; values: pinned values; verify: parameter sets never seen, so no link and no read until verified; verify_data: links allowed, but the named data or side-effect claim is unconfirmed, so the feature using it stays off; link: shell | insis-only. structure and nodes: en/cs labels, the single source. external: links outside InSIS. Checked by scripts/ia_check.py.

structure._comment: Destinations, groups and blocks with their labels (single source with nodes).

help: Nápověda a na koho se obrátit

transient_params._comment: Parameters InSIS adds for navigation; the crawl normalised them away. InSIS+ never adds them to URLs it builds. On links copied from InSIS pages they are tolerated as below; any other parameter must match the page's allowed sets.

lang.rule: only on InSIS's own language links, copied verbatim

zpet.rule: tolerated on copied links if its value is an /auth/ URL that itself passes the URL rule (checked recursively); otherwise dropped

back.rule: same as zpet (base64-encoded URL: decoded, then checked)

_m.rule: tolerated on copied links (menu item id); exempt from the _* deny pattern
_m.verify: confirm with an un-normalised snapshot that _m has no side effect (menu or favourites state)

external._comment: Links outside insis.vse.cz that InSIS+ may show. 'copied': only when copied verbatim from an InSIS page. Everything else outside InSIS is never linked.

/auth/.note: InSIS's main page is Home itself: its menu, counters and notices are read when the student opens Home, never in the background

/auth/anketky/dotazniky.pl.note: background read only while the optional To do item is switched on

/auth/devel/.note: InSIS 'Error when using information system' page

/auth/dok_server/.verify_data: course-folder links matched to my courses

/auth/dok_server/nove_dok.pl.note: opened only by the student; the New course files notification uses the main-page counter instead

/auth/dok_server/slozka.pl.note: Course › Files links to the folder; InSIS+ never reads it (opening may mark files as read)

/auth/help.pl.note: context help of each page: '?' in the page header

/auth/hledani/.note: thematic search; Ctrl+K covers most of it

/auth/int/podani_prihlasky.pl.note: stays verify: the application form page was never opened (only its link was seen)

/auth/kontrola/.note: the To do item comes from the notices on InSIS main page, not from this form page

/auth/mistnosti/.note: public room list, read on the first room search

/auth/student/list.pl.note: lectures sheet: regular assessment per course; notification settings
/auth/student/list.pl.verify_data: that reading it when the course page opens marks nothing as seen; course-folder links

/auth/student/moje_studium.pl.note: the portal dissolves: its links go to their nodes; restriction column feeds To do; studies table becomes the study switch

/auth/student/temata_prihlasovani.pl.note: topic rows matched to a course by the course code in the row

/auth/student/terminy_info.pl.note: exam date details; the list of registered students is only InSIS's own link on this page

/auth/student/terminy_seznam.pl.note: every exam action happens here, shown unchanged; InSIS+ adds a summary above and highlights the course

/auth/system/logout.pl.note: named exception: avatar › Log out is InSIS own logout link, opened only by the student

/auth/vv/sprava/externi_vyzkumnici.pl.note: InSIS 'Error when using information system' page

/auth/vv/zaznamnik/vysledky.pl.note: InSIS 'Error when using information system' page

menu_only._comment: Main-menu items whose pages are outside /auth/ or were not opened; mapped by their menu label.
